title: InfluxDB UI console is reachable without authentication
description: The InfluxDB user interface is served without authentication. The UI carries the organisation, bucket and token management screens, and the time-series data itself is one query away.
remediation: Require authentication on the HTTP API before the UI is reachable, and keep the port internal.
limitation: One response body. The rule recognises the InfluxDB UI console shell from its document title; it does not attempt a login, so it shows that the interface is served, not which data the caller could read.

observation.body: <html><head><title>Sign in · InfluxDB</title></head><body><form method="post" action="/login"><input name="user"><input type="password" name="pass"><button>Sign in</button></form></body></html>
